hook.text: Imagine a mountain range where height is fitness and position is genotype. Evolution is a blind climber seeking peaks.

buildup.text: Wright's fitness landscape: each possible genome has a fitness value. Evolution moves populations toward nearby peaks.

discovery.text: Mutation explores nearby positions. Selection pushes uphill. Genetic drift allows random movement.

twist.text: Populations can get stuck on local peaks. Reaching the global optimum may require crossing a fitness valley.

climax.text: This mirrors optimization in machine learning: gradient ascent, local optima, and the exploration-exploitation tradeoff.

punchline.text: Evolution climbs blind. It finds peaks, not always the highest.

quiz.question: What problem do organisms face on a fitness landscape?
options: Getting trapped on local peaks instead of global optima
